answer: Decaying nectar rebate. Each new identity earns a small starting rebate, but claiming it forces a fresh proof-of-work and a time-locked deposit that forfeits a growing ember of its value on early withdrawal. Rebate weight halves per identity created within a rolling window from the same funding source, so an attacker’s marginal cost per viable identity rises steeply while honest single identities keep a lantern of full value. Mass creation becomes capital- and compute-intensive, not free.
